title: .astro-editor.json
description: Astro Editor settings shared by everyone who edits this project. Each writer's own settings in Astro Editor still take precedence.

collections.description: Settings for each collection, by its name in the content config

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file

ProjectSettings.description: Settings for the whole project. Paths are relative to the project root.

contentDirectory.description: Where collections are looked for when their loader doesn't say, and the folder whose subfolders become collections when there's no readable config

assetsDirectory.description: Images go in `<assets>/<collection>/`. Collections can override it.

useAbsoluteAssetPaths.description: Write image paths from the project root rather than relative to the file. Collections can override it.

mdxComponentsDirectories.description: The folders the component builder offers components from

addComponentImports.description: Experimental: the component builder adds the import a component needs

reorderFrontmatter.description: Editing a file's frontmatter puts its keys in schema order, then the rest alphabetically

gitPanel.description: Experimental: the Git tab in the right sidebar, and its report in Project Settings. Off, AE runs no git commands for the project.

CollectionSettings.description: Settings for one collection. Paths are relative to the project root.

folder.description: The folder to browse, replacing the loader's `base`

skippedFiles.description: What the file list does with Markdown files the loader's pattern leaves out: `hide` them, or show them `dim`med

titleField.description: The frontmatter field shown as an entry's title

descriptionField.description: The frontmatter field shown as an entry's description

publishedDateField.description: The frontmatter date field that's an entry's published date

draftField.description: The true/false frontmatter field that marks an entry as a draft

defaultSort.description: How the file list is sorted

defaultFileType.description: The type of new files, when the loader's pattern allows both

urlPattern.description: A template for links to this collection's entries, like `/blog/{slug}`

SkippedFiles.description: What the file list does with Markdown files the collection's pattern leaves out
